# sustain_monitor (Data Source)

A monitor the workspace has, of any type, by its id or its name: what other resources name it by.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A monitor made in the console, by its name, so a service made here can take it.
data "sustain_monitor" "website" {
  name = "Website"
}

resource "sustain_service" "shop" {
  name     = "Shop"
  monitors = [{ monitor_id = data.sustain_monitor.website.id }]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Its id: given, or found by its name.
- `name` (String) Its name, exactly as the workspace has it, which only it may have: given, or read by its id.

### Read-Only

- `type` (String) Its type: `http`, `tcp`, `udp`, `dns`, `ping`, `mail`, `grpc`, `browser` or `heartbeat`.
